payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CNN model consistently outperforms other models in various tasks related to offensive language identification, achieving the highest macro-F1 scores in the reported experiments.

claims.text: The CNN model achieved the best performance in discriminating between offensive and non-offensive posts with a macro-F1 score of 0.80.
In the task of identifying insults and threats, the CNN outperformed the BiLSTM model with a macro-F1 score of 0.69.
Overall, a CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results across all sub-tasks evaluated.
